headline: Professor Murder Rides the Subway is a forgotten slice of dance punk perfection
summary: Rediscover the forgotten dance-punk gem, Professor Murder Rides the Subway EP. The mid-aughts NYC indie scene had a unique sound, exemplified by this band. This concise EP offers a perfect blend of dance and punk.

headline: Enormous 12TB Steam leak includes abandoned Half-Life 2: Episode 3 assets
summary: A massive 12TB leak exposes Steam builds from 2003-2013. The data includes assets for the canceled Half-Life 2: Episode 3. Content cut from Portal 2 and other forgotten gems are also surfacing.

headline: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope launches to study dark matter and dark energy
summary: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has successfully launched after funding delays. It will journey a million miles to orbit at the Sun-Earth L2 point. The telescope is set to conduct an unprecedented survey, focusing on dark matter and dark energy.

headline: Texas Governor Abbott blocks funding for more Flock cameras
summary: Texas Governor Greg Abbott froze state spending on Flock AI surveillance cameras. The move follows growing public backlash against the camera technology. A Texas Tribune investigation revealed the state spent over $30 million on Flock cameras, funded by insurance fees.

headline: Lanterns: This Is Why They Changed John Stewart’s Origin Story in Episode 3
summary: Lanterns showrunner Chris Mundy explains John Stewart's altered origin story. The change is directly linked to the "termination" of the Manhunters. Episode 3 reveals key plot developments behind the character's new background.

headline: The Best Books For Summerween 2026
summary: Discover the top horror books for Summerween 2026. The list includes everything from slasher novels to viral TikTok hits. Get ready for spooky reads this summer, if you dare.

headline: Save On These Excellent Razors at Amazon Right Now
summary: Find great deals on top-rated razors during Amazon's latest sale. The selection covers both manual and electric razor options. Upgrade your grooming routine with these discounted picks.

headline: 12TB of Steam Files Leak as a Decade’s Worth of First- and Third-Party Game Data Is Exposed
summary: A massive 12TB leak exposes a decade of Steam game data. The archive contains both finished and unfinished builds from 2003-2013. First- and third-party game content has been compromised.

headline: Once a village, now barren land - BBC in the valley devastated by floods
summary: The BBC reports from Sano Barkhu, a Nepalese village devastated by recent floods. The village, once vibrant, now stands as barren land overlooking Syfrubesi. Witness the severe impact of the flooding in Nepal.

headline: Sir Mel Stride replaced as shadow chancellor as Conservatives reshuffle top team
summary: Sir Mel Stride has been replaced as shadow chancellor. Andrew Griffith takes over the role in the Conservative reshuffle. The change is part of Kemi Badenoch's shadow cabinet reorganization.

headline: Dolly Parton laid to rest alongside husband in Nashville
summary: Dolly Parton has been laid to rest in a private family funeral. The legendary singer passed away on Tuesday at the age of 80. She was buried alongside her husband in Nashville.

headline: Early release scheme could see dangerous criminals released, Conservatives warn
summary: Conservatives warn an early release scheme risks freeing dangerous criminals. The prime minister proposed releasing some prisoners with indefinite sentences. The plan aims to increase prison capacity.
